notes: LMP-estimation PROC SQL pattern adapted from getga.sas (%getga). Computes, per gestational-age encounter, the days between pregnancy outcome and encounter, an estimated LMP via a CASE on the day gap (follow-up vs pre-outcome), and an outcome-keyed gestational-age-table LMP. The CASE expressions, calculated-column references, date arithmetic, left join and the gestational-age lookup table are the repo's, unchanged; display-only column LABELs were omitted (FORMAT= retained). autoexec supplies small mock pregs/ga_enc datasets matching the shape the query reads. Mock data is illustrative; no real claims data. Computed LMP values were hand-verified against the day arithmetic.
